blurb: Guests can visit the lakeside-meets-mountains tap room in Squamish to enjoy a variety of craft beers including core and seasonal brews. The brewery offers beer by the glass, flights, growler fills, and cans or bombers to take home. The tap room is family friendly, dog friendly on the patio with policy, and welcomes outside food with beverage purchase.
